question: State the important observation made in the Davisson and Germer experiment for electrons accelerated by $54\,\text{V}$. What did this observation prove?

options.A: For electrons accelerated through $54\,\text{V}$, a strong intensity maximum was observed at a definite scattering angle from the nickel crystal. This indicated electron diffraction, and the agreement with de Broglie wavelength proved the wave nature of electrons.
options.B: At $54\,\text{V}$, electrons were found to stop completely, proving that they have no wave nature.
options.C: At $54\,\text{V}$, no scattering was observed, proving that electrons are uncharged.
options.D: The intensity of scattered electrons was the same at all angles, proving that electrons behave only as particles.
